Event photography

You enjoy the moment. I’ll make sure you remember it.

You’ve spent weeks planning. Choosing decorations, ordering flowers, sorting out the food, sending the invitations and fussing over a hundred little details nobody else will notice, but you will.

Then the day finally arrives, and you’re busy greeting guests, answering questions, refilling the punch and making sure everyone’s happy. By the end of it, you’ve barely taken a single photo.

That’s where I come in.

Let’s Capture Your Event →

My photography style

The best moments aren’t always the posed ones.

I prefer to blend naturally into the background and let the day unfold. The moments I love most are the ones nobody planned:

  • Laughter between friends
  • A proud smile during a retirement speech
  • The reaction to a surprise party
  • A grandparent holding a baby
  • Meaningful, in-between interactions
  • Decorations and personal touches
  • Guests simply enjoying themselves

I’m always happy to take any group photos you’d like (Grandma will want one with all the cousins). But candid photography is my main style, and it’s what I love doing most.

Why hire an event photographer?

You deserve to be in the photos, too.

The host always ends up behind the camera, or never has time to pick it up at all.

Years from now, you’ll want photos of the people who came, the speeches, the hugs, and yes, you. I want you to actually enjoy your event instead of spending it worrying about capturing everything. Be a guest at your own party. I’ve got the camera.

Events I photograph

Celebrations big, small and in between

If you’re gathering people together for something that matters to you, I’d love to be there.

  • Work holiday parties

    Your team, dressed up and off the clock. A thank-you worth remembering, without anyone stuck taking photos.

  • Baby showers

    The gifts, the games, the happy tears and all the sweet little details you planned for the parent-to-be.

  • Retirement parties

    Speeches, stories and proud smiles as you celebrate years of hard work and everything that comes next.

  • Birthdays and milestones

    First birthdays, fortieths and ninetieths. Candles, cake and the people who make the years count.

  • Anniversary parties

    Decades of love in one room: old friends, family stories and a few moments that are just for the two of you.

  • Family gatherings

    Reunions, holidays and long-awaited get-togethers, with every generation finally in the same place.

  • Community events

    Festivals, open houses and celebrations that bring the whole town out. The stuff small towns do best.

  • Fundraisers

    Show the people, the effort and the generosity behind your cause, and share it with supporters afterward.

The little details

All those little things you worked so hard on? I notice them.

The handmade centrepieces. Grandma’s recipe on the dessert table. The flowers you picked out, the memory table, the guest book, the banner your kids made.

Those details are part of the story of your event, and they deserve to be remembered as much as the people. I make a point of photographing them early, before the candles burn down and the cake gets cut.

What to expect

Easy, relaxed and all about you

  1. We’ll talk beforehand

    We’ll chat about your event, the schedule, the people and the feel of the day.

  2. You share your priorities

    Tell me your must-have moments, special guests and any specific photo requests.

  3. I photograph naturally

    I capture the day as it unfolds, mostly candid, with any group photos you’d like.

  4. I won’t disrupt the celebration

    My aim is to blend in, so your guests can relax and enjoy themselves.

  5. We agree on coverage

    Together we’ll decide how much of the event you’d like covered, so it’s clear up front.

Pricing

Every celebration is a little different.

So event photography is quoted individually, based on how long your event is, where it’s happening and how much coverage you’d like.

Tell me about your plans and I’ll send you a clear, no-pressure quote.

Website design for small businesses

A website that works hard, so you don’t have to.

You didn’t start your business because you wanted to spend your evenings updating a website. You started it because you’re good at what you do.

I get it. You don’t need complicated technology. You need customers to find you, understand what you offer and get in touch. That’s exactly what I build.

Let’s Get Your Business Online →See Packages

$1,000one-page websites, all-in

Why a website matters

Your customers are looking online. Can they find you?

Word of mouth is still the best advertising there is. But when a neighbour recommends you, the next thing most people do is look you up. If they can’t find you, or can’t find what they need, they may move on to someone they can.

  • Get found

    Show up when people search for what you do, and for your business by name.

  • Build credibility

    A polished website tells people you’re established, professional and open for business.

  • Make contact easy

    Your phone number, email, hours and a contact form, right where people expect them.

  • Answer questions

    Cover the things customers always ask before they ever pick up the phone.

  • Save time

    Fewer repeat questions and back-and-forth messages means more time for your actual work.

  • A home of your own

    A consistent online presence that doesn’t depend on Facebook or Instagram’s latest changes.

A good website gives people a clear, trustworthy place to learn about you. No one can honestly guarantee search rankings or a set number of new customers, and I won’t pretend to.

My approach

Simple doesn’t mean second best.

I won’t sell you features you don’t need.

Some businesses only need a single, beautiful page. Others need a few pages to explain their services properly. I keep the process straightforward and build your website around what your business actually needs.

You don’t need to write it all yourself.

I’ll learn about your business, write the copy and source appropriate licensed stock photography. You just tell me what you do and who you do it for. I’ll take it from there.

Who I am

This website is run by Chelsey, owner of Small Town Chatter, a small business offering website design and photography in the Ottawa Valley, Ontario, Canada. If you have any questions about this policy or your information, email me at smalltownchatter@gmail.com.

What information I collect

When you send a message through the contact form, I receive the information you choose to provide:

  • Your name and email address
  • Your business name, town or location, and event date (if you include them)
  • The service you’re asking about and the message you write

If you email me directly, I receive your email address and whatever you include in your message. I don’t ask for sensitive information through this website, so please don’t include things like payment details in the form.

How I use it

I use the information you send only to:

  • Reply to your inquiry and answer your questions
  • Prepare a quote or proposal you’ve asked for
  • Keep a record of our conversation if we end up working together

I won’t sell, rent or trade your information, and I won’t add you to a mailing list or send you marketing messages without your permission.

How contact form messages are handled

This website is hosted on Netlify, and the contact form is processed by Netlify’s form-handling service. When you submit the form, Netlify receives and stores the submission and sends a notification to my email inbox (a Gmail account provided by Google). Netlify also uses automated spam filtering on form submissions. These service providers may store and process information outside of Canada. You can read more inNetlify’s privacy policy andGoogle’s privacy policy.

How long I keep it

I keep inquiries only as long as I reasonably need them to respond to you, provide any services we agree on and keep ordinary business records. After that, I delete them.

Cookies and tracking

This website doesn’t use advertising cookies, and it doesn’t currently use analytics or tracking tools. Like any website, the servers that deliver it (Netlify for the site, and Unsplash for some of the stock photographs) may automatically log basic technical information, such as your IP address and browser type, to deliver and secure their services.

Your choices

You can ask me at any time what information I have about you, ask me to correct it, or ask me to delete it. Just email smalltownchatter@gmail.com and I’ll take care of it.

Changes to this policy

If the way this website handles information changes, I’ll update this page and the “Last updated” date above.
